scope: Six new ordinary guests and six reserve partners integrated into the existing game.

sourceBaseline.method: Copied the pre-existing working tree into a temporary directory, restored only task-edited clean files to their pre-task HEAD contents, omitted the new expansion test, and ran src tests in both copies. All other user edits were retained. Comparison is by file and full test name.

browser.profile: Isolated temporary agent-browser session; game onboarding and partner profile inspection did not modify the user’s browser save.

limitations: Full repository suite is not green. Source baseline comparison confirms 118 existing failures; script and historical evidence tests were not baseline-compared.
New staff use individually configured existing cozy-team-v7 artwork; only the guest atlases were newly image-generated.
